description: Manage a project CI/CD job token inbound allowlist. Actions: set_enabled (turn allowlist enforcement on/off), add_project / remove_project (grant or revoke a project), add_group / remove_group (grant or revoke a group). Required to allow cross-project CI_JOB_TOKEN access once the legacy open-access mode is removed. Related: browse_job_token_scope to inspect.

action.description: Action to perform: set_enabled, add_project, remove_project, add_group, remove_group

enabled.description: When true, only allowlisted projects/groups may access this project via CI_JOB_TOKEN. Required for 'set_enabled' action(s).

project_id.description: Project whose job token scope is modified. Numeric ID or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group/project' or '123').

target_group_id.description: Numeric ID of the group to add/remove from the inbound allowlist. Required for 'add_group', 'remove_group' action(s).

target_project_id.description: Numeric ID of the project to add/remove from the inbound allowlist. Required for 'add_project', 'remove_project' action(s).

name: manage_job_token_scope
